meta_data.base_class: Sets <a specific type of personal recurring reminder>. - This is a general purpose reminder application that allows setting a reminder message, a specific time, and recurring days of the week, suitable for various personal activities or habits that require daily or weekly scheduled reminders.
meta_data.base_class_entity: reminders for sleep and wake-up times to improve sleep habits

tool_template.name: Set_<class>_Reminder
tool_template.description: An application to set <class> reminders for timely notifications.

reminder_message.description: Custom message for <class> reminders. Must be between 10 and 100 characters.

reminder_time.description: Time to send the <class> reminders. Format should be HH:MM in 24-hour format.

days_of_week.description: Days of the week to send <class> reminders. Should be a list of days like ['Monday', 'Wednesday'].

priority_level.description: The priority level of the <class> reminder, which should be 'low', 'medium', or 'high'.

notification_type.description: Type of notification for <class> reminders, being 'popup', 'email', or 'SMS'.

reminder_duration.description: Duration in minutes for how long the <class> reminder should be active. Must be at least 1 minute.

snooze_enabled.description: Whether snooze is enabled for <class> reminders, allowing temporary dismissal with a later repeat.
